description: Figure 1 presents a bar chart illustrating the average performance and token usage of the Chain of Unconscious Thought (CoUT) method alongside several baseline models across four Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) and four benchmarks. The horizontal axis displays the benchmarks – GSM8K, MATH, MMLU, and DROP – listed alphabetically. The vertical axis represents performance, labeled as “Accuracy (%)”, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, and tick marks at 10-unit intervals. The chart consists of grouped bars for each benchmark, with each group containing four bars representing the four LRMs: Llama2-7b, Llama2-13b, Llama2-70b, and GPT-4. Within each group, the bars are ordered from left to right corresponding to the LRM order listed above. Each bar is color-coded to represent a specific LRM, with Llama2-7b in blue, Llama2-13b in orange, Llama2-70b in green, and GPT-4 in red. For GSM8K, the accuracy values are approximately 48%, 58%, 72%, and 93% for Llama2-7b, Llama2-13b, Llama2-70b, and GPT-4, respectively. A second, lighter-colored bar is stacked on top of each accuracy bar, representing the token usage, with the vertical axis labeled “Tokens”. The token usage values are not explicitly labeled with numeric values, but the stacked bars indicate a consistent increase in token usage with CoUT compared to the baseline models. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
